_comment: REFERENCE FILE - DO NOT EDIT, CLONE IT. It is overwritten on Management Pack upgrade.
Clone it in Configurations > Management Packs Configuration and enter the clone's name in the adapter instance.
metricSets[].adapterKind / resourceKind: object type, e.g. VMWARE / VirtualMachine
metricSets[].metrics: case-sensitive stat keys, e.g. cpu|usage_average
metricSets[].maxSampleAgeMinutes (optional): skip the delta if the newest sample is older
Result metric: <Metric Group>|<stat key>, default group 'Custom Metrics|Delta'. Nothing is stored if fewer than two samples exist.
